input.subject: Your report about Flat 12 – Flat 11, 40 Crown Parade (ref R/10)
input.body:
Dear tenant,

Thank you for telling us about the noise from Flat 12 and the people in the stairwell at 40 Crown Parade (ref R/10). I'm sorry you've gone weeks without proper sleep.

This isn't a repair, so I've passed it to a member of our property management team. They will contact you about next steps, including whether we manage Flat 12 or the building's communal areas. We'll be in touch within 2 working days.

In the meantime:
- If you ever feel unsafe or see a crime happening, call 999.
- To report suspected drug dealing or antisocial behaviour that isn't an emergency, call the police on 101 or report it online. You can also report anonymously to Crimestoppers on 0800 555 111.
- For noise late at night, you can contact the local council's environmental health/noise team. Keeping a simple log of dates, times and what you heard will help them, and us.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team
